name: pii-redaction-engine test shell
description: Minimal unpacked extension. Verifies the parts of MV3 integration that are genuinely new risk: dynamic import() of the local engine module from a content script's isolated world, DOM-layer detection on a real page, and fetch() of a remote HF model URL under host_permissions. Does NOT re-run full onnxruntime-web/tesseract.js inference here (that's proven in demo/) — see README for why, and for the bundling requirement those libraries need for production.
